Nora (CS): quick roundup from today's onboarding calls: recurring asks - bulk export of feature asks, clearer per-route cost labels, and a manual embeddings reindex trigger.
Ben (PM): good catch. which of these are renewal-sensitive?
Nora (CS): two enterprise customers called out invoice surprises tied to routing defaults. one in a 30-day renewal window. marked as high risk.
Ivy (SE): rough effort: export CSV ~1.5d, per-route cost label change ~3d (backend + UI), reindex button depends on infra but estimate ~4d. need a telemetry event `feature_request.submitted` for reliable batching.
Nora (CS): sample quote to include in tickets: "We can't tell which routes are burning our credits. We only notice when the bill hits."
Ben (PM): thanks. I'll create tickets and add a renewal-risk tag. prioritize export + labels as quick wins.
eng-bot: created TKT-9034 "Feature-asks bulk export" and TKT-9035 "Per-route cost labels". assigned TKT-9034 -> @Ivy.
Ivy (SE): slating export for next sprint. will need a small migration to store route display names with token counts.
Nora (CS): i'll compile the raw asks and renewal dates, send scored list by EOD.
Ben (PM): perfect. once we have the scored list, we'll schedule customer outreach for the high-risk accounts. :phone:
Nora (CS): will do. thanks team!
